query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN usedHours >= totalHours THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as exhausted_by_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN endDate < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as expired_by_date
FROM packages 
WHERE isActive = true;
